description: This file contains mock implementations of various services used in an Android TV frontend project, including services for likes, content, and APA metadata/assets. It provides in-memory and simulated network responses for testing or development purposes.

classes.name: MockLikesService
classes.description: Mock implementation of LikesService to simulate like-related API interactions.

classes.name: MockContentService
classes.description: Mock implementation of ContentService to generate sample content data.

classes.name: MockAPAService
classes.description: Mock implementation of APAService to provide sample metadata and assets.

methods.name: getLike
methods.description: Simulates retrieving like data for a specific group ID.

methods.name: postLike
methods.description: Simulates posting a 'like' or 'dislike' for a specific group.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Simulates fetching content information for a specific group ID.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Provides mock APA metadata settings and legend keys.

methods.name: getAssets
methods.description: Provides mock APA asset URLs such as icons for like, love, dislike, and close.
